# Event Intelligence — documentation for coding agents and LLMs

> Host-neutral pre-v1 SDK for durable future conditions, event-time
> correlation, source provenance and targeted wakeups; not an LLM runner.

Package: `mcp-event-intelligence` (Node.js >=22).
Preview version at this repository's source date: `0.12.0-next.1`
(`next`, not npm `latest`). Verify current version and exported APIs;
the stable `1.0.0` release has not been approved.

This file is a convenience index only. It is not an MCP endpoint, an
agent-executable configuration or a guarantee that arbitrary LLM clients
will auto-discover the repository.
